Title: STRESS TEST FEATURE
Author: Pipeline QA

INT. OFFICE LOBBY - EVENING

DEV sits alone, phone pressed to their ear.

DEV
(into phone)
Can you hear me?

RAHUL (O.S.)
(distant, crackling)
Barely. Say that again.

INT. ROOFTOP CAFE - NIGHT

RAHUL, MEERA, and SURESH gather around a small table, voices overlapping.

RAHUL
We don't have much time.

MEERA
Then let's not waste it arguing.

EXT. TRAIN STATION - MORNING

MEERA and SURESH stand inches apart, neither backing down.

MEERA
(sharp)
You promised me this wouldn't happen again.

SURESH
(quiet, guilty)
I know.

INT. RIVERSIDE PARK - DAY

SURESH's bike weaves through traffic, engine roaring past the riverside park.

SURESH
(shouting over the wind)
Hold on!

INT. OLD BOOKSHOP - EVENING

KAVYA sits alone, tracing a finger along the edge of the table. The silence stretches.

EXT. COLLEGE CANTEEN - NIGHT

ANIKA arrives at the college canteen, scanning the room before stepping inside.

ANIKA
(to herself)
Finally.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - MORNING

DEV sits alone, phone pressed to their ear.

DEV
(into phone)
Can you hear me?

RAHUL (O.S.)
(distant, crackling)
Barely. Say that again.

INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY

RAHUL, MEERA, and SURESH gather around a small table, voices overlapping.

MEERA
Then let's not waste it arguing.

INT. CITY APARTMENT - NIGHT

SURESH's bike weaves through traffic, engine roaring past the city apartment.

SURESH
(shouting over the wind)
Hold on!
